select c.belong_id archiveId, count(distinct a.id) count from (select * from materials_list where business_type = "ARCHIVES") c left join archive_file_type a on c.materials_type = CAST(a.id AS CHAR)
a.need = 1 and c.belong_id in
#{item}
group by c.belong_id

select b.template_id templateId, count(a.id) count from archive_file_type a left join archive_type_group b on a.group_id = b.id
a.need = 1 and b.template_id in
#{item}
group by b.template_id

select a.type_name typeName,a.id from (select * from archive_file_type where need = 1 and group_id in (select id from archive_type_group where template_id = #{templateId})) a left join (select * from materials_list where business_type = "ARCHIVES" and belong_id = #{archiveId}) c on c.materials_type = CAST(a.id AS CHAR) where c.id is null
